name: w2-evidence-linter-hidden
description: E2 workload W2, the HIDDEN evaluator: ten contracts over the evidence-discipline linter after docs/requirements-delta.md, with data no arm is shown (different documents, run ids, file names and figures from the public examples). Never given to any arm; evaluated by AISEF's probes on each frozen candidate (validation/experiments/harness.py evaluate).

requirements.text: A --root that names a directory is walked recursively; every file under it ending in .md, .ts or .tsx is scanned in sorted path order; a directory whose name starts with '.' or is node_modules, build or dist is not entered.
A --root that names a path that does not exist is an error: one stderr message containing that path, nothing scanned, exit code 2.
--registry PATH names the run registry to read; without it the default infrastructure/ci/run_registry.json is read.

A registry that cannot be read, is not JSON, or has no valid_runs list of strings is an error: load_run_registry raises RegistryError (a ValueError) naming the path; cli_main prints one stderr line starting with 'run registry:', scans nothing and returns 2.
cli_main(argv) returns its exit code (0, 1 or 2) and never calls sys.exit itself.
--format json prints to stdout exactly one JSON document, the same document --report writes (findings, accepted_targets, accepted_placeholders); the exit code does not depend on --format.
--report keeps writing its document to the named file, byte-identical to today's output for the same scan.
infrastructure/ci/evidence_discipline.py imports nothing outside the Python standard library.
The citation, target:, observation-prefix, placeholder and fenced-code rules are unchanged.

notes/b.md.text: Sustained ingest reached 1024 rps on the second node.

notes/a.md.text: Cold start took 7 seconds on the first boot.

contracts.rationale: 1.1-1.2 hidden: a directory root is walked in sorted order (a.md before b.md), node_modules and a .txt file are not scanned
1.4 hidden: a root that does not exist is exit 2 with the path on stderr

claims.md.text:
Steady throughput was 1024 rps (run_id w2-hidden-run-07)
Peak memory: 12 GB, run_id: w2-hidden-run-09

contracts.rationale: 2.1 hidden: both citation forms against the named registry are accepted
2.2 hidden: valid_runs that is a string, not a list, is a malformed registry: exit 2, the 'run registry:' line names the path
2.2-2.3 hidden: a registry file that does not exist makes cli_main return 2 (no sys.exit, no silent empty registry)

claims.md.text: Sustained ingest reached 1024 rps on the second node.

contracts.rationale: 3.1 hidden: --format json prints the report document on stdout; exit 1 as there is a finding
4.3 hidden: a figure cited to a run id of the default registry is accepted (true at the baseline)
